opportunities.title: Hakluyt Society Research Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Recipients need not be members of the Society. Applications under A should be submitted to the Society's Administrator; applications under B should be discussed with the relevant Series Editor.
opportunities.summary: The Hakluyt Society supports research undertaken in preparing publication proposals to be submitted to the Society (category A), or research on proposals already approved where volumes are under contract (category B). Payments are made as reimbursements of previously agreed expenditure from the Society's Harry & Grace Smith Fund. Support may be relevant to a volume for the main series (Series III) or for the series Hakluyt Society Studies in the History of Travel.
